[[Zumi]] (Sister)|age=16}} '''Texen''' is the reserve Fighting-type Gym Leader who takes over after [[Keta|Keta’s]] death as both the Gym Leader and the Sensei of [[Sheridan Village]]. He doesn’t care at all about the responsibility of the role, and uses it only boost his own ego and reputation due to feeling overshadowed by his successful older sisters, [[Zumi]] and [[Risa]]. __TOC__ __FORCETOC__
== Appearance == Texen is a pale-skinned boy with orange hair that is style as if to resemble devil horns. His eyes are a pale blue, and he wears a white collared shirt with a black tie and a blue sweater vest over the shirt. He wears a pair of brown cargo shorts, white crew length socks, and deep gray-blue shoes. == Personality == Off the rip, Texen expresses himself as a rampant misogynist and stereotypical “alpha male.” He doesn’t take anything particularly seriously, and is obviously using his position of power to gain social status and attention from those around him. Texen’s attitude is somewhat explained during his second confrontation with [[Aelita]], who taunts him about how the only reason he acts the way he does is due to his much more successful older sisters, Zumi and Risa. His faux confidence all but disappears after he loses his position to Aelita, compounded by the reveal of his sister’s death. While he attempts to keep up his “alpha” attitude, he’s clearly struggling and deeply loathes the [[Protagonist]] and their friends for “ruining” what he had. == Biography == ===Those We Lose=== The younger brother of Zumi and Risa, Texen makes his first appearance in the story when the Protagonist and Aelita head back to Sheridan Village to investigate [[Caratos Mountain]]. Sheridan Village is a mess, and the two make their way to the Sensei’s house, where Texen is inside throwing a massive party. Aelita confronts him about the disaster going on inside, with the two butting heads before Texen attempts to ban Aelita from Sheridan Village forever. Aelita challenges him to a battle in response, and Texen, letting his ego get one over him, allows her to battle alongside the Protagonist. After he loses and the arena starts catching fire as the magma in the mountain flows over, he curses about how it was “unfair” before panicking as his hair is set on fire by the spreading flames. After the group travels through the [[Garufa Sanctuary|ruins]] deep within the mountain and Aelita is cursed, Texen attempts to get [[Cella|the Eldest]] to ban Aelita and the Protagonist again. After the Eldest tells him no, he throws a bigger fit before storming off. Texen makes a brief appearance again in Club STFU, reveling in Aelita’s condition and claiming he’ll destroy the Protagonist next time they meet. ===Death of One, Birth of Another=== After Aelita’s curse is broken and she goes through the three Springs spread across Aevium, she encounters Texen again. Texen’s attitude is pushing more and more people away from him, and Texen grows even more irritated when he sees Aelita, gloating to her that Sheridan Village is still “his” and there’s nothing she can do about it. Aelita challenges him for the Sensei position over the village, and while Texen rejects it at first, is goaded into it. If Aelita wins, she takes over as Sensei, but if Texen wins, Aelita is banned forever – and has to kiss Texen. Despite his best efforts, Aelita stomps Texen in battle. She questions him on why he wanted to even be the Sensei, and Texen brushes off the question with a “because I can” response. Aelita questions that if, in reality, the reason he took the position was to get over of his sisters’ shadows, which causes Texen to fall into a rage of denial. With the help of Kai’ya and a long conversation, Texen leaves Sheridan Village and returns to [[Grand Dream City]]. ===.Karma Files=== In the Paragon Route, Texen can briefly be seen during the [[Rose Theatre]] quest in the hot springs. He makes a snide remark at the Protagonist and is briefly involved with the group in figuring out what’s going with the Theatre. He and [[Erin]] banter during it, with the two in a weird way somewhat getting along despite their vast differences, perhaps showing a different side to Texen he doesn’t want others to see. Regardless, following the quests completion, Texen returns to Grand Dream City. == Pokémon == Story Mode= === Texen's House === Texen is battled on [[Big Top Arena]] in a 6v4 Double Battle with [[Aelita]] as the player's partner.

{{ PokemonCard | index = 392 | specie = Infernape | gender = ♂️ | types = fire/fighting | ability = Iron Fist | nature = Jolly | level = 72 | heldItem = Life Orb | move1 = Flare Blitz;fire;physical | move2 = Slash and Burn;grass;physical | move3 = Thunder Punch;electric;physical | move4 = Close Combat;fighting;physical | evs = 0;252;0;0;0;252 | ivs = 31 }} }} == Relationships == ===[[Protagonist]]=== Texen cannot stand the Protagonist and views them on the same level as Aelita, blaming them for his losing of Sheridan Village and the benefits that came with it. ===[[Aelita]]=== Texen absolutely loathes Aelita, and Aelita acts as something of a “perfect foil” for him. His chaotic anger is perfectly matched by her cool-headed nature during their last encounter, with his childish antics paralleling her leadership qualities. While originally disliking him greatly, Aelita appears to pity Texen more than anything. ===[[Erin]]=== During the Paragon Route, Texen and Erin have something a positive relationship mostly based off the fact that Texen doesn’t immediately give into Erin’s insults and Erin enjoys messing with him. ===[[Risa]]=== Texen’s older sister. The two are implied to have a complicated relationship, but Texen grieves heavily for her once her death is revealed to the public. ===[[Zumi]]=== Texen’s oldest sister. The two have no on screen interactions, so the status of their relationship is unknown. == Quotes == * ''“I AM ALPHA!”'' * ''“I’ll blow you guys so far back you’ll need three plane tickets before you even get close to me again!”'' * ''“DON’T DISS THE DO!!”'' == Trivia == * Texen placed 52nd in the 2nd official popularity poll with 28 votes, tied with [[Odessa]], [[Ariana]], and [[Geara]]. *Zumi being Texen's older sister was something Jan did without Zumi's input - Zumi promises to get him back for it on her own user page. == Gallery == ===Sprites=== ====Chapter 8==== {{Gallery|size=150|Texen VS.png{{!}}VS portrait.
